title: Addition to 100
subtitle: Sums 51 to 100
bounds: Facts bounds (PROTOCOL 4c, briefs/facts2): the whole run inside sums 51 to 100, easy to hard by tier. Prompt forms: R 'a + b = ?' (answer s), C 'a + ? = s' (answer b), S '? + b = s' (answer a); every number a non-negative integer. T1 R, an operand a non-zero multiple of ten. T2 R, no multiple of ten and the ones stay under ten: >= 8 with a one-digit operand, >= 8 with both two-digit. T3 the same with the ones making a ten. T4 C, a, b >= 2, no multiple of ten (>= 12 regrouping). T5 S (>= 12, >= 6 regrouping) and C (>= 6 regrouping), a, b >= 2, no multiple of ten. Prompts unique per tier, 24 per tier. Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers <= 999, >= 2 near the answer (+-1, +-2, +-10), at most 1 far; answer rank among the 4 values 15-35% each per tier; answers >= 20 always have a wrong choice sharing the ones digit (+-10); the answer is never the only value of its parity.

tiers.name: No regrouping
tiers.description: Tens and ones, the ones stay under ten: 52 + 34.

tiers.name: Regrouping
tiers.description: The ones make a new ten: 47 + 38.

ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Count again: start at the bigger number and count up.
ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted on wrong: the sum is one more or one less than the true sum.

SUBTRACTED.student: Plus means put together. Add the two numbers, don't take them apart.
SUBTRACTED.teacher: Subtracted the smaller addend from the larger instead of adding: 8 + 5 = 3.

NO_CARRY.student: The ones made a new ten. Add that ten in with the tens.
NO_CARRY.teacher: Dropped the regrouped ten when the ones summed to 10 or more: 38 + 47 = 75.

TENS_SLIP.student: Check the tens place. Add the tens, then the ones.
TENS_SLIP.teacher: Tens digit of the sum is one too many or too few, with the ones right: 34 + 52 = 76 or 96.

MISSING_ADDED.student: Don't add the two numbers you see. Find the missing one: subtract.
MISSING_ADDED.teacher: Added the shown number and the total instead of subtracting: 7 + ? = 15 answered 22.

MISSING_ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Add your answer to the shown number and check the total.
MISSING_ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted up wrong: the missing number is one more or one less than the true one.

MISSING_TENS.student: Check the tens. Add your answer to the shown number: is it the total?
MISSING_TENS.teacher: Missing number is ten too many or too few: forgot the trade counting up across a ten, or a tens slip.
